description: This file contains internal implementation of a WOLA (Weighted Overlap-Add) based audio filter, including functions for similarity measurement, dot product calculations, energy computations, and search algorithms for optimal audio segment alignment.

methods.name: InInterval
methods.description: Checks if an integer n is within the interval q.

methods.name: MultiChannelSimilarityMeasure
methods.description: Calculates similarity measure across multiple audio channels based on dot product and energy.

methods.name: MultiChannelDotProduct
methods.description: Computes the dot product between two multi-channel audio segments, optimized with SIMD if available.

methods.name: MultiChannelMovingBlockEnergies
methods.description: Calculates energies of overlapping blocks within an audio input for each channel.

methods.name: QuadraticInterpolation
methods.description: Fits a quadratic curve to three points to find the extremum and its value.

methods.name: DecimatedSearch
methods.description: Performs a decimated search for the best matching segment index based on similarity.

methods.name: FullSearch
methods.description: Performs an exhaustive search within specified limits to find the optimal segment index.

methods.name: OptimalIndex
methods.description: Finds the best matching index of a target audio segment within a search segment, considering exclusion intervals.

methods.name: GetSymmetricHanningWindow
methods.description: Generates a symmetric Hann window of specified length.
